subject.title: Feature Request: Add premium request % to /usage footer

question: Should per-response `/usage` footers perform a bounded provider-usage lookup, or should quota footer text wait for cached/preloaded provider quota state?
rationale: The requested behavior is clear and source-reproducible, but the active implementation deliberately trades a short final-reply delay and omit-on-timeout behavior for inline quota visibility.

options.title: Accept bounded lookup
options.body: Land the active PR after ordinary review, accepting that cold provider quota lookups can omit quota text after the timeout while preserving the base footer.

options.title: Require cached quota state
options.body: Ask the implementation to preload or cache provider quota snapshots so final reply delivery does not wait on a quota probe.

options.title: Keep `/status` as quota surface
options.body: Decline inline quota footers and keep provider quota visibility limited to `/status` and related status surfaces.

recommendation.title: Accept bounded lookup
recommendation.body: Land the active PR after ordinary review, accepting that cold provider quota lookups can omit quota text after the timeout while preserving the base footer.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete scoped this issue in a prior comment and has the strongest history on the provider-usage/status seam reused by the active implementation.
